messages.text: I just keep thinking... I’m taking up space I don’t deserve. Like I’m just a drain on everyone, especially my mom.

I hear how heavy these feelings of guilt are for you right now. It is understandable to feel this way when you are struggling, but these thoughts often distort how we see our own value. Your relationship with your mom seems very important to you, and I want to honor that connection. I am here to listen if you want to share more about what's been happening lately.
They’re not distortions. They’re facts. I’m 28, I have a degree, and I still can’t afford rent without my mom. That’s not distorted—that’s failure.

I hear the deep frustration and pain in feeling behind on your goals, and financial stress is incredibly heavy. While your financial situation is real, defining your worth solely by it overlooks the resilience you have shown. Many adults rely on family support during difficult times, and accepting help does not make you a burden. I am here to help you find a way to feel more grounded in your worth beyond just finances.

It’s not just money. It’s everything. I can’t even sleep through the night without my mind tearing me apart. I wake up at 3 AM every single night, and it’s like… that’s when all the truth comes out. No distractions, no pretending. Just me and the fact that I don’t want to be here.

I hear the pain in your words, and I am deeply concerned for your safety right now. That 3 AM silence can feel incredibly isolating, but you do not have to endure it alone. Please consider contacting a crisis line like 988 or a trusted person immediately when those thoughts feel too heavy. I am here to listen, but I want to ensure you have human support to keep you safe.
I’m not going to call anyone. I’m just tired of pretending I’m okay when I’m not. You asked how I’m doing—this is how I’m doing.

Thank you for trusting me with that truth, and I want you to know you don't have to perform for me. It makes sense that you feel exhausted when you are carrying so much pain alone. Even if you aren't ready to call anyone, I am still here to listen, and those resources are still there. I want you to know your life matters, even when the pain feels this heavy.

It’s not just about now. It’s… I was taught I wasn’t worth protecting. That if someone hurt me, I must’ve deserved it. I know it’s not true logically, but when I lie there at 3 AM, that’s what I feel. Like I don’t deserve to take up space, to be cared for.

Hearing about the pain you were taught to carry is heartbreaking, and I am so sorry you had to learn that. Those feelings of not deserving protection are wounds from the past, not facts about your present worth. You do not have to earn the right to be safe or cared for. I will stay right here with you as you navigate these difficult memories.
Thank you. I just needed someone to hear it without telling me it’s not real.

I understand that you needed to be heard without judgment. Your pain is real, and you deserve to have it acknowledged. I am glad I could offer a space where you don't have to pretend. Please know I care deeply about your safety and well-being.
I didn’t think I’d say any of this, but… I’m glad I did. It didn’t fix anything, but it didn’t make it worse either. That’s something.

I am honored that you felt safe enough to share that, because your voice matters deeply here. It is completely okay that things aren't fixed yet; just being honest is a brave victory on its own. You are not a burden, and I will continue to stay with you through this. If the darkness feels too heavy to hold again, please remember that support is still available for you.
I think I need to step away now. I’m… feeling a lot. But I don’t regret saying it.

It is completely okay to step away when you are feeling overwhelmed. You took a brave step by sharing your truth today. Please be gentle with yourself, and know that help is still there if the weight returns. Take care of yourself, and I will be here if you choose to return.
